title.original: Oneiros: KV Cache Optimization through Parameter Remapping for Multi-tenant LLM Serving
title.zh: Oneiros：通过多租户LLM服务的参数重新映射进行KV缓存优化
title.en: Oneiros: KV Cache Optimization through Parameter Remapping for Multi-tenant LLM Serving

inclusion_reason.zh: Oneiros 把多租户模型参数重映射为 KV 容量，形成可复用的 GPU 内存虚拟化与缓存管理运行时。
inclusion_reason.en: Oneiros turns inactive tenant weights into KV capacity through reusable GPU-memory remapping and cache-management runtime mechanisms.

abstract.zh: Oneiros 观察到模型参数在运行期保持不变，而 KV 缓存持续更新，因此不再频繁换出 KV，而是重映射参数占用的显存给缓存使用。多租户场景中，暂时不活跃模型的参数空间可被更积极地回收。
abstract.en: Oneiros exploits the fact that model parameters are static while KV state changes continuously: instead of swapping KV data, it remaps parameter memory for cache use. In multi-tenant serving, parameter space belonging to inactive models becomes reclaimable capacity.

problem.zh: 传统 CPU 换出会反复搬运不断变化的 KV 缓存，产生大量主存流量，尤其难以支撑多个模型共享 GPU。
problem.en: Conventional CPU offload repeatedly moves dynamically updated KV state, creating heavy memory traffic when several models share a GPU.

approach.zh: Oneiros 将较少访问或不活跃模型的参数迁往 CPU，并把释放的 GPU 地址空间重映射为 KV 缓存，从而避免高频 KV 双向交换。
approach.en: Oneiros moves less-active model parameters toward CPU memory and remaps the freed GPU address space to KV blocks, avoiding repeated bidirectional KV transfers.

system_design.zh: 运行时跟踪租户模型活跃度并管理参数映射，在需要切换模型时利用高带宽 CPU–GPU 链路恢复参数；缓存则保留在 GPU 可直接访问的位置。
system_design.en: The runtime tracks tenant activity and parameter mappings, restoring model weights over a high-bandwidth CPU–GPU link when a model becomes active while keeping KV data in GPU-addressable memory.

key_results.zh: 在 Grace Hopper 类高带宽平台上，Oneiros 相比 vLLM 被报告可降低 TTFT 与 token 间隔的尾延迟，并提高吞吐。
key_results.en: On a high-bandwidth Grace Hopper platform, Oneiros is reported to reduce tail TTFT and inter-token latency while increasing throughput over vLLM.

limitations.zh: 方案依赖高 CPU–GPU 带宽和可回收的不活跃参数空间；当租户频繁切换或所有模型同时活跃时，参数恢复可能重新成为瓶颈。
limitations.en: The design relies on strong CPU–GPU bandwidth and reclaimable inactive weights; rapid tenant switching or simultaneous model activity can turn parameter restoration back into the bottleneck.

notes.zh: 硬件、vLLM 基线和三个区间结果来自官方摘要；具体模型、请求分布与各区间对应条件待全文审计。
notes.en: Hardware, the vLLM baseline, and three result ranges come from the official abstract; models, request distributions, and conditions behind each range await full-text audit.
